The simulation uses the pimpleFoam solver for a transient, incompressible, laminar flow past a cylinder.
The mesh is one cell thick in the spanwise direction, representing a 2D domain.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, the frontAndBack patches are defined with type empty.
In 0/U, the frontAndBack boundary condition is set to type empty with no value entry.
The inlet boundary condition in 0/U is fixedValue with a uniform freestream velocity of (0.5 0 0) m/s.
The outlet boundary condition in 0/U is zeroGradient for velocity.
The cylinderWall boundary condition in 0/U is no-slip, set to fixedValue uniform (0 0 0).
The cylinder diameter is 0.05 m.
In constant/transportProperties, the kinematic viscosity nu is set to 1.5e-5 m^2/s, giving a Reynolds number of approximately 167, which is within the laminar regime.
In constant/transportProperties, the turbulence model is set to laminar.
In 0/p, the frontAndBack boundary condition is also set to type empty to match the mesh definition.
All other pressure boundary conditions (inlet, outlet, cylinderWall) are set with standard incompressible pressure BCs (e.g., zeroGradient at inlet, fixedValue at outlet, zeroGradient at cylinderWall).
The case uses a standard pimpleFoam system/controlDict with a transient time-stepping scheme appropriate for capturing vortex shedding at Re ~167.
